scientific.integrity: The final claim separates the all-orders structural proof from finite exhaustive verification and does not claim the previously published complete-graph or complete-bipartite scalar cases as new.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs.
The finite verifier covers order at most 10; arbitrary order is justified by the symbolic proof.
The complete-graph and complete-bipartite scalar values are prior-covered and are used only as checks.
Poorly indexed literature under related accurate-domination terminology remains a residual originality risk.

title: Connected accurate domination of complete multipartite graphs
